author: ETA PRIME
description:
In this video, we test the highly anticipated Forza Horizon 6 on all the mainstream Windows gaming handhelds! I was given early access to check out the performance, and we are running benchmarks across the Legion Go 2 (Z2 Extreme), MSI Claw 8 AI (Intel Ultra 258V), ROG Ally X, and the ROG Xbox Ally (Z2 A).

Buy a windows handheld here: https://bestbuycreators.7tiv.net/enNMYX

We test 17W, 25W, and 30W TDPs, dive into the graphics settings, and see how FSR 3.1.5 and Intel XeSS impact frame rates. Is 60FPS possible on a handheld? Let's find out!
